title: Open the Books
subtitle: The house takes its share on the spot
description: Four emeralds buys the ledger's attention, and the ledger's
attention is the cheapest thing in the building.
This chapter sets `defaultConsumeItems: true`, so the press hands
the emeralds over. That is the house's own default, written once on
the chapter manifest -- every task here consumes unless it says
otherwise, and one of them does. Watch for the paper.
